about.title: About the Promo Set 2
paragraphs: Promo Set 2 lists the 38 Disney Lorcana promo cards numbered 1/P2 to 36/P2, from products and promotions and organised play.

They come from Disney Villainous: Introduction to Evil boardgame, Products and promotions, Organised play, Stitch Gift Set, Into the Inklands bundle, Lilo Gift Set, Moana 2 release and ’Illumineer’s Quest: Palace Heist’ victory card.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
